name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx web server for three virtual hosts, including static content, redirects, TLS, security headers, Fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis authentication, log-directory management, configuration cleanup, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python runtime setup, PostgreSQL installation and database/user creation, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
